open_points.subject: 00_product.md:Decisions
open_points.text: “a room is never renamed or removed afterwards” and “the owner, before making the export on the VPS, corrects there every room name”
open_points.question: Is the pre-export correction an explicit exception to R0-10, or must it occur without renaming the existing room?
options: Add a one-time source-side rename exception that preserves the room id
Transform the name only in the export
Exclude every project containing a nonconforming room
open_points.default_guess: Add a one-time source-side rename operation that preserves the room id and is available only before migration.

witness.initial: A picked VPS project has an existing room named “bathroom for the wheelchair”.
events: The owner checks the room before export.
The owner attempts to correct its name.
outcomes: R0-96 requires the room name to be changed before export.
R0-10 requires the room never to be renamed.
witness.observer: The owner and, after import, the agent reading the room name.

open_points.subject: 00_product.md:Decisions
open_points.text: “An archived project ... cannot be corrected” and “every room name of the projects to be picked that breaks this rule”
open_points.question: May the owner correct a room name in an archived source project before export, and if so, what exact exception overrides R0-12?
options: Permit a one-time migration-only correction of archived source data
Rewrite the name in the export without correcting the archived source
Refuse to import that archived project
open_points.default_guess: Permit an explicitly scoped migration-only source correction that changes only room names and preserves all identities.

witness.initial: An archived VPS project selected for import contains a prohibited room name.
events: The owner selects the archived project for migration.
The owner performs the required pre-export correction.
outcomes: R0-96 requires correction of every violating room name.
R0-12 forbids correction of an archived project.
witness.observer: The owner and the agent that later reads the imported project.

open_points.subject: 00_product.md:Decisions
open_points.question: What concrete source-side action lets the owner find and correct a room name on the VPS, and what are its input, authorization, output and failure result?
options: A dedicated one-time migration command that lists and renames rooms
Direct manual editing of the source store
Editing names in an intermediate export file
An existing v1 operation, identified explicitly
open_points.default_guess: Provide a one-time authenticated migration command on the VPS that takes room id and replacement name, preserves the id, reports the resulting value, and fails without partial change.

open_points.subject: 00_product.md:Decisions
open_points.text: “the owner ... corrects there every room name ... that breaks this rule”
open_points.question: What must happen when a violating name cannot be corrected or the correction process is incomplete?
options: Abort export until every selected project passes the check
Omit the affected project from the export
Allow import and record the unresolved violation
Require the owner to edit the export before upload
open_points.default_guess: Abort export and identify the project and room that still require correction.

witness.initial: A selected project contains a violating room name that the source cannot change.
events: The owner attempts the required correction.
outcomes: The export is refused because the promised precondition was not met.
The export succeeds because no specified action checks or reports the failed correction.
witness.observer: The owner, and later the agent if the project is imported.

open_points.subject: 00_product.md:Decisions
open_points.text: “the projects to be picked” and “the import then copies names the owner has already checked”
open_points.question: How is the subset checked before export bound to the subset the owner later picks at import, given that the import accepts any subset and refuses no name?
options: The export contains only checked projects
The export records a checked-project allowlist enforced by import
The owner may pick any exported project based only on procedure
The owner repeats the room-name check after making the final import selection
open_points.default_guess: Make the export contain only the projects whose rooms were checked, and allow import to select only from that set.

witness.initial: The VPS holds projects A and B; only A's room names were checked, while B contains a prohibited name.
events: At import, the owner picks B.
Registry imports B without inspecting its room names.
outcomes: B is accepted because the import accepts whatever the owner picks and refuses no name.
B is refused or unavailable because only prechecked projects may be picked.
witness.observer: The owner and the agent receiving B's room name.

open_points.subject: 00_product.md:Decisions
open_points.text: “before making the export ... corrects there every room name” and “The import then copies names the owner has already checked”
open_points.question: What prevents a room from being added or otherwise changed after the owner's check but before the export snapshot is made?
options: Quiesce source writes before checking and exporting
Check the completed export rather than the live source
Perform the check and export atomically
Accept the procedural race
open_points.default_guess: Quiesce writes, check the exact source snapshot, and create the export from that snapshot.

witness.initial: An active selected VPS project has only conforming room names when checked.
events: The owner completes the room-name check.
Before export, a caller adds a room with a prohibited name.
The owner makes and imports the export.
outcomes: The new unchecked name is imported because no freeze or second check is required.
The export is blocked or rechecked so every copied name has actually been checked.
witness.observer: The owner and the agent reading the newly imported room.

open_points.subject: 00_product.md:Decisions
open_points.text: “The import then copies names the owner has already checked”
open_points.question: What fact or observable result establishes that every copied room name was checked, and who records or verifies it?
options: The export carries a signed or confirmed check attestation
The export tool emits a complete validation report retained by the owner
Import confirmation includes an explicit owner attestation
No evidence is kept; compliance relies solely on the owner's memory
open_points.default_guess: Have the export tool produce a report for the exact export snapshot and require the owner's confirmation that all reported room names were reviewed.
